title: Provision EventBridge Schedule Rule
scenario: Your platform team needs EventBridge Schedule Rule for a scheduled automation trigger. Write a reusable Terraform configuration that provisions it, drives every input through variables, applies the standard tags, and exports the operational identifiers.
constraints: Create exactly one resource of type aws_cloudwatch_event_rule.
All configurable values must come from variables declared in variables.tf.
Code must pass terraform fmt conventions (2-space indents, trailing newline, no tabs).
Tag the resource with Project, Environment and ManagedBy = "terraform".
